name: gohighlevel/api-client
description: Official PHP SDK for the GoHighLevel API

suggest.ext-curl: Recommended for better HTTP performance with Guzzle
suggest.ext-mongodb: Required for MongoDB session storage (PECL mongodb extension)
suggest.mongodb/mongodb: Required only if you use HighLevel\Storage\MongoDBSessionStorage. Use ^1.17 on PHP 7.4/8.0, ^1.17|^2.0 on PHP 8.1+.
